addons.title: Aura Forge
addons.notes: Shows your buffs and debuffs on your action buttons. Made for WoW: Forever. Based on AdiButtonAuras by Adirelle.

addons.title: CopyCat
addons.notes: Catches Lua errors and opens them pre-selected so you can Ctrl+C instantly. /cc

addons.title: Familiar Faces
addons.notes: Remembers who you played with, which zones and which quests.

addons.title: Fireside Forever
addons.notes: Preview campfire buffs before you sit, and see which camp objects you can craft. /fs

addons.title: Forget-Me-Not(e) Forever
addons.notes: Your leveling helper: new spells, profession milestones and recipes, and class quests.

addons.title: Glimmer
addons.notes: Always shows the loot sparkle on quest items, and keeps it on after graphics changes.

addons.title: Globus
addons.notes: A clean, borderless world map: just the map and your quest tracking. Zoom in very close with the mouse wheel, drag to move, resize from the corner. /globus

addons.title: Glowcery List
addons.notes: Shows a buy icon on vendor items you need for tracked recipes.

addons.title: Lingua
addons.notes: Tags German and French chat and shows an English translation on hover. /lingua

addons.title: Objective Forever
addons.notes: Replaces the default quest tracker: your quests, tracked recipes with reagent counts and - with QuestMates - your party's quests.

addons.title: Parley
addons.notes: Instant-messenger style whisper windows with history that survives /reload and logout.

addons.title: Postmark
addons.notes: Shows a pending mail icon with total gold incoming from auction house sales (1 hour mail delay).

addons.title: Provisions
addons.notes: Keeps macros pointed at your best water, food, potions, healthstone and bandage. Mage-made first.

addons.title: Quest Ledger Forever
addons.notes: The classic separate quest log, with modern features: quest chains, 3D arrow, reward upgrades, quest levels at quest givers, quest-starter item popups, party quests (QuestMates) and more. /ledger

addons.title: QuestLock Forever
addons.notes: Protects quest items and profession tools from being sold or deleted by mistake.

addons.title: QuestMates
addons.notes: Shows your party members' quests on the world map in their own color, plus a list of who is on what. Also marks quest links in chat as done/in log. Everyone in the group needs QuestMates.

addons.title: Rally Point
addons.notes: Filters for Blizzard's Looking For Group browser (role, class, level), members inline, match alerts, whisper helper. Includes Dungeon Dossier: dungeon quests in your log and to pick up (/dq) and map waypoints to quest givers and chain starts.

addons.title: Recap
addons.notes: End-of-session summary card: time, XP, gold, quests, deaths, loot and a fun stat. /recap

addons.title: Reload Button
addons.notes: Adds a Reload UI button to the Esc Game Menu.

addons.title: RollCall
addons.notes: Tracks /roll results, shows a live leaderboard and remembers who won.

addons.title: Scribe
addons.notes: English spellcheck for chat, with WoW terms and acronyms.

addons.title: Talent Scout
addons.notes: Talent presets for WoW Forever: left-click a spec to preview a Damage, Tank or Healer build, right-click for presets or to record your own. /tsc
